IPCA
Commissioners Ofice
September 5, 1980
Mr. Tom Mau LORILLARD 666 Fifth Avenue New York, N.Y. 10019
Dear Tom:
Attached are two copies of the Co-Sponsorship Agreement between Lorillard Tobacco, a Division of Loews, Inc. and the LPGA-TPC for the 1981 Golden Lights Championship.
As indicated in the Co-Sponsorship Agreement, this Agreement represents a standard contract acceptable to all LPGA tournament sponsors under common terms. The only exception to the standard language would be as represented by a differentiated tournament format.
After you have read through the attached Agreement, please sign both copies, returning both to the LPGA for signing by Mr. Volpe. I will then return one fully executed copy of the contract to you. for your files .
Thank you.
Sincerely , Kathy Oliviaw
Kathy D'Aloisio Secretary to Ray Volpe :Kad Attachments
